landing.metaTitle: StockSafe: stop throwing away expired medicines
landing.metaDescription: Free, open-source stock and expiry tracker for hospital stores and pharmacies. Know what expires in 90 days and what runs out next week.
landing.heroSub: Free, open-source stock and expiry tracker for hospital stores and pharmacies. Know what expires in 90 days and what runs out next week.
landing.heroVisualLabel: Example of the expiry centre, with demo data
landing.problemTitle: Monthly hand checks. Paper bin cards. Shelves that go empty without warning.
landing.problemSub: Stores and pharmacies in small and public hospitals often run on paper bin cards and Excel. Expiry is checked by hand once a month, so near-expiry batches are found too late, and reorders happen only after a shelf is empty.

evidence.north: Studies of public health facilities in two North Indian states report gaps in the availability of essential medicines and weak storage and record-keeping.
evidence.puducherry: Studies in Puducherry report gaps in the availability of essential medicines and weak storage and record-keeping.
evidence.gap: Governments use state systems (DVDMS / e-Aushadhi) for warehouses, but many CHCs, nursing homes, trust and NGO hospitals have nothing free and simple for their own store and dispensary.

receive.title: Receive with batch and expiry
receive.text: Enter or scan the batch number and expiry date for every delivery. Nothing goes into stock without them.

issue.title: Issue earliest-expiry-first, automatically
issue.text: The system picks the batch that expires first and never issues an expired one. You see the split before you confirm.

alert.title: Get alerts before it is too late
alert.text: See what expires in 30, 60 and 90 days, with its value, and what is below its reorder level, every morning.

landing.trustText: Every movement is recorded and can never be edited, ready for audit.
landing.installSub: Runs on a PC with 2 GB of RAM. Needs Docker. No internet is needed once it is running.
landing.installNote: Open http://localhost:3002 and sign in with the demo accounts shown after the last command. A single PC with no Docker can also run it: see the README.

dvdms.a: No. It can export to it: items and stock import and export as CSV, so it sits beside the state systems.

internet.a: No. It works on the hospital network. Email alerts are optional.

free.a: Yes. It is open source under the MIT licence.

audit.intro: Every change: who, what and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted. Times are India time.

strings.Usable stock is not yet expired. Values: Usable stock is not yet expired. Values are quantity times the batch's cost price.
strings.Days left is negative for stock that has: Days left is negative for stock that has already expired.
strings.Consumption = issued + dispensed. Transf: Consumption = issued + dispensed. Transfers between stores are not consumption. Written-off stock is shown separately and is not in the value.
strings.A items are the few that make up the fir: A items are the few that make up the first 80% of consumption value, B the next 15%, C the rest. Spend the most care on A items.
strings.Items with no consumption in the period: Items with no consumption in the period are not listed.
strings.A stock-out day is a day that ended with: A stock-out day is a day that ended with no usable (non-expired) stock. Days before an item was first stocked are not counted.
strings.Only items with at least one stock-out d: Only items with at least one stock-out day are listed.
